visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A female doctor wearing yellow scrubs, a white mask, and a specialized head-mounted lens works on a patient lying down. She applies a blue chemical peel substance to the patient's face using a cotton swab. (2) Close-up shots of a laser treatment in progress; a red targeting laser is visible, followed by the actual laser pulses creating small, neat rows of micro-holes on the blue-tinted skin. (3) The doctor uses a precision pen-like tool to treat individual spots on the forehead, with visible micro-bleeding and skin texture changes. (4) The doctor uses her gloved hands to point at the treated areas, explaining the results as the camera captures the red punctate marks on the patient's face. (5) Final title card displaying clinic logos and contact information.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Subtitle]: 治療痘疤吧. (2) [Variety]: multimodality. [Subtitle]: 我認為最重要的一個多種的. (3) [Subtitle]: 協同式的治療. 意思就是說. 沒有一個治療. 就是會治好痘疤. 他一定是多種東西. (4) [Subtitle]: 像這個病人. 他已經先擦過藥. 我們把他造成他痘痘的原因. 都已經控制住. (5) [Subtitle]: 那我們現在用的是一個TCA換膚. [Variety]: blue peel. (6) [Subtitle]: 然後等一下. 還會再幫他打UP雷射. [Variety]: UP雷射施打中. (7) [Subtitle]: 這個是打完第一層的UP雷射. 我們UP雷射會打兩層. [Variety]: perfect. (8) [Subtitle]: 它就是會有這些局部的出血點. 就是要打到真皮層裡面. 把那個皮打穿了之後. 那個血會跑出來. (9) [Subtitle]: 所以我們知道我們打在那一層. 一定有穿透整個疤痕組織. [Variety]: 痘疤精雕治療. (10) [Subtitle]: 因為它這個是增生性的疤痕. 它其實是從裡面. 凸出來的一些痘疤. 看起來很恐怖. (11) [Subtitle]: 但是其實. 疤痕也只能這樣治療. 世界長能過唯一做到的. 治療. (12) [Subtitle]: 就只有這台機器. [Logo]: DRX DERMATOLOGY CLINIC. [Slogan]: 歡迎聯繫我們 contact us.
